instruction: 2つ目のシーンに動画クリップを入れて
explanation: 2つ目のシーン（scene-02）の背景を画像から動画クリップ assets/clips/life-tone-4s.mp4 に変更しました。クリップの指定がなかったため、シーンの長さに最も近い4秒のクリップを選びました。別のクリップがよければお知らせください。
summary: scene-02: image "assets/sample.png" -> none; video none -> assets/clips/life-tone-4s.mp4 (freeze)

instruction: Play the background clip in scene 1 in slow motion
explanation: Scene 1 (trim-speed): the background clip's speed changes from 2× to 0.5× for slow motion. The trim (1–4 s) is unchanged, so the clip is now longer than the scene and gets cut at the scene's end.
summary: trim-speed: video assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 1000..4000 ms, 2x, freeze) -> assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 1000..4000 ms, 0.5x, freeze)

instruction: 第三段的视频播完后循环播放，不要停在最后一帧
explanation: 第三段（freeze）的视频片段已设置为 fit_time=loop，1 秒的裁剪片段播完后会重新循环，不再停在最后一帧。
summary: freeze: video assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 4000..5000 ms, freeze) -> assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 4000..5000 ms, loop)

instruction: Make the picture-in-picture video in scene 4 play twice as fast
explanation: In scene 4 (pip), the picture-in-picture video layer's speed goes from 0.75 to 1.5, which is twice as fast.

instruction: 5つ目のシーンの動画の音を消して
explanation: 5つ目のシーン（sound）の動画の音量を設定から外してミュートにしました。
summary: sound: video assets/clips/life-tone-4s.mp4 (trim 500..end ms, freeze, volume 0.5) -> assets/clips/life-tone-4s.mp4 (trim 500..end ms, freeze)

instruction: In scene 6 use only seconds 0.5 to 1.2 of the clip
explanation: Scene 6 (seam-a) now uses only 0.5 s to 1.2 s of the clip. That is 700 ms of footage for a 1600 ms scene, so the last frame will freeze for the rest.
summary: seam-a: video assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 0..1600 ms, freeze) -> assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 500..1200 ms, freeze)

instruction: 在第一段右上角加一个小画中画视频，用 assets/clips/gradients-2s.mp4，循环播放
explanation: 在第一段（scene-01）右上角添加了一个小画中画视频图层（gradients-2s.mp4），设置为循环播放。

instruction: Replace scene 2's background image with the clip assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4, starting 1 second into the clip
explanation: Scene 2 (scene-02) now uses assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 as its background, starting 1 second into the clip; the image is removed.
summary: scene-02: image "assets/sample.jpeg" -> none; video none -> assets/clips/counter-6s.mp4 (trim 1000..end ms, freeze)

instruction: Use /Users/me/Movies/holiday.mov as the background of scene 1
